0003.citation: HL7 Table 0003 - Event type; Chapter 2 reserves the Znn trigger events for site definition, so the printed rows are not a closed set

0076.citation: HL7 Table 0076 - Message type; Chapter 2 reserves the Zxx message types for site definition, so the printed rows are not a closed set

0104.citation: HL7 Table 0104 - Version ID; MSH-12 may carry a locally agreed version identifier, so the printed rows are not a closed set

0396.citation: HL7 Table 0396 - Coding system; the table itself prints the local forms 99zzz and L, so the printed rows are not a closed set
0396.note: Four Values wider than their column ran into the Description (text lines 10652, 10701, 11123, 11254) and their wrapped Description lines parsed as rows. 'CE (obsolete)' and '(deprecated)' under ISOnnnn (line 10978) are status annotations printed in the Value column, not part of the code; v2.4 and v2.5.1 print the same row as plain CE.

0399.citation: HL7 Table 0399 - Country code; the values are ISO 3166 by reference, not enumerated by HL7, so the printed rows are not a closed set

0211.note: v2.8.2 Chapter 2C runs a footnote marker and its URL through the Value column of Alternate character sets (text lines 6030-6033). Verified against v2.5.1 and v2.6, which print the same table without either.

0207.note: Processing mode prints 'Not present' = 'the default, meaning current processing'. The printed row denotes an ABSENT field, not a literal value: the Validator only checks populated values, so the row is not a code.

0335.note: Chapter 2C wraps the row label 'Meal Related / Timings' over two lines (text lines 8789-8790); the second line was emitted as its own row.

0368.note: An explanatory paragraph and an example EAC^U07 message follow the table with no separator (text lines 9791-9814); three of its lines parsed as rows. The table ends at AT.

0340.note: '(HCPCS)' is the wrapped tail of HPC's Description 'CMS (formerly HCFA) Procedure Codes (HCPCS)'.

0354.citation: HL7 v2.8.2 Table 0354 - Message structure. The printed rows are NOT an exhaustive set: the chapters are normative for message structures and the table lags them. Measured on this version: 25 structures that the chapters' own trigger and example lines use are absent from the printed table (v2.5.1 Chapter 15 defines RSP^K25^RSP_K25, which Appendix A omits). Enforcing it would reject messages the specification itself defines (req #4).

0301.note: Universal ID type prints one row whose Value is 'L,M,N': three codes, each 'reserved for locally defined coding schemes', not one. Kept as a single code the closed table rejected a valid HD.3 of L, M or N (a live misfire in v3.4.0's component check). Split into three rows carrying the printed description.

0528.note: Event related period prints HS ('the hour of sleep'); the RPT section's own example is '|QHS&Every day before the hours of sleep&HL7xxx^^^^1^d^^AHS|' (sec 2.A.66), whose RPT.8 'AHS' is in no row. Codes are matched exactly, so the closed table rejected the specification's example; the example's spelling is accepted beside the printed rows.
addEntries: Spelling used by the specification's own RPT example (before the hour of sleep); not a printed row

0203.note: V282-C01: v2.8.2 CH02C sec 2.C.2.140 HL7 Table 0203 prints the row NNxxx, 'National Person Identifier where the xxx is the ISO table 3166 3-character (alphabetic) country code'. It names a family of codes (NNAUS, NNCAN, ...), not the literal NNxxx, so it is modelled as a pattern row. V282-C02 (owner gate G5): opened; out-of-table identifier types are spec-compliant under 'suggested values'.
0203.citation: HL7 v2.8.2 CH02C sec 2.C.2.140 Table 0203 - Identifier Type; CH02A sec 2.A.14.5 (CX.5) 'Refer to HL7 Table 0203 - Identifier Type for suggested values', so the printed rows are not a closed set

0920.citation: HL7 v2.8.2 Chapter 2C sec 2.C.2.544, HL7 Table 0920 - Preferred Specimen/Attribute Status; its only governing field, OM4-16 (CH08 sec 8.8.12.16), reads "Refer to HL7 Table 0920 - Preferred Specimen/Attribute Status in Chapter 2C, Code Tables, for suggested values", so the printed rows are not a closed set
0920.note: P2-fix 2: open under the ADR-016 criterion (governing field prose cites the table for suggested values).

0617.citation: HL7 v2.8.2 Chapter 2A sec 2.A.87.18 XAD.18 Address Usage, User-defined Table 0617 - Address Usage (CH02C 2.C.2.481 prints the caption HL7 Table 0617 and names XAD.18 as its only use)
0617.note: P2-fix 2: XAD.18, the only governing field, reads "Refer to User-defined Table 0617 - Address Usage for valid values". Under the ADR-016 criterion the chapter prose wins, so the kind is User (P2-4 0119 precedent, in reverse). v2.6 sec 2.A.85.18 prints "HL7 Table 0617" inline and stays HL7.
